title: Scaffold: Worker, Durable Object, web app, CI and previews
steps: Open the Preview. Cloudflare Access asks you to sign in before anything loads.
The page says it's running, the email you signed in with, and that the workspace has 3 notes: Welcome, Reading list and this one.
Open the Preview's address in a private window and skip sign-in, or run `curl -i` on `/api/me`: you get Access's sign-in page or a 401, never the app.
